parity.asvs: the same extracted model reaches ASVS; the attribute agreement gain is package neutral, and the effect on ASVS applicability is unmeasured because no ASVS run was made
parity.stride: the change: the extraction prompt both packages read, measured here on STRIDE leads and on the neutral attribute scores

candidate.reason: case 12 holds unknown in 5 of 5 sweeps and no measured score fell

falsifier: with the rule, case 12's category-manager flow stays unknown in fewer than 4 of 5 sweeps, or attribute agreement, flow.authentication agreement, endpoint recall or kept STRIDE leads fall by more than 0.5 sd of the before spread
hypothesis: extraction copies the case 12 datasheet phrase 'fully authenticated' into the category-manager flow's authentication because prompts/extract.md has no rule for a general product claim, and that stated control stops the spoofing-unverified-boundary-auth lead for must-find 12/1
intervention: added rule 8 to 'Reading what a source says' in prompts/extract.md (a claim about a whole product sets no control attribute on one element; keep unknown and quote it in notes); ran 5 extraction sweeps on main and 5 with the candidate prompt through ANALYSIS_PROMPTS_DIR, alternating, luna base tier on OpenRouter
reconsider_when: prompts/extract.md rule 8, the case 12 corrections or the extraction tier's model change
scope: 16 corpus cases (the two holdouts are exhausted and count as development cases), 5 extraction sweeps each side at 0558b6685b3345de3e5bf46006e9c39fa53c1725, openai/gpt-5.6-luna through OpenRouter pinned to openai/flex, prompt digests 87c2732b544b (before) and b0567eb0a503 (after). Case 12 category-manager authentication: before fully authenticated in 4 of 5 sweeps, after unknown in 5 of 5. Must-find 12/1 lead: before kept 1 of 5, after 5 of 5. Attribute agreement 0.781 to 0.787 (+3.3 sd); flow.authentication agreement 0.946 to 0.969 (+4.6 sd); endpoint recall 0.766 to 0.780 (+0.3 sd, inside the spread); kept STRIDE leads 90.4 to 98.4 a sweep. The kept-lead gain is partly a validity effect: 4 of 5 before sweeps lost one case each to a Tier 1 invalid-reference failure (cases 07 and 16, among others) and 0 of 5 after sweeps did; that difference is not attributed to the rule, and 5 sweeps a side cannot separate it from chance. Over valid cases only, the kept share of led must-finds is 0.932 before and 0.974 after. A lead is a correlate of a match, not a match: the effect on matched must-finds and on ASVS is unmeasured.
signature: an extracted System Model writes a vendor's whole-product claim as one element's control attribute
